description:
Extract structured data from a webpage via Zenrows.

Returns JSON fields (products, articles, listings) rather than a full page body.
Modes:
- auto (default): extract=auto, site-tailored Extract (currently free,
  billing may apply later). Works on any domain Zenrows has prepared, with any
  API key; falls back to autoparse when the domain isn't prepared yet (REQS007)
- autoparse: general-purpose structured JSON on any domain
- css: css_extractor with an explicit selector map

Requests use automatic mode (mode=auto) by default: Zenrows enables JS rendering and
premium proxies only when the site needs them, and charges only for the
configuration that succeeds. Pass just the URL.
Set js_render or premium_proxy only to force a fixed configuration; that turns
automatic mode off and bills every request at that configuration's cost.

Check "empty" in the result: true means no field came back with a value.
"noDataExtracted": true means Extract processed the page and found nothing to
extract (not charged); retrying the same request returns the same answer.
Full-page markdown, HTML and screenshots come from scrape.

css_extractor.description: Required when mode=css. JSON map of field→selector, e.g. '{"title":"h1","price":".price"}'

fallback_autoparse.description: When mode=auto and the domain isn't prepared for Extract yet (REQS007, or the legacy AUTH010), retry once with autoparse (default true)

js_render.description: Force JS rendering on every request. Overrides automatic mode (mode=auto), which already renders when needed.

mode.description: Extraction mode: auto (extract=auto, default), autoparse, or css (requires css_extractor)

mode_auto.description: Automatic mode (mode=auto) is on by default; leave unset. False sends a plain request without it.

premium_proxy.description: Force premium residential proxies on every request (10x cost). Overrides automatic mode (mode=auto), which already uses premium proxies when a page needs them.

proxy_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Works in automatic mode (mode=auto); with js_render or mode_auto=false it requires premium_proxy.

url.description: The webpage URL to extract from

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after load. Requires js_render=true; without it, including in automatic mode, it may be ignored.

wait_for.description: CSS selector to wait for before extracting. Requires js_render=true; without it, including in automatic mode, it may be ignored.

name: extract
